enabled.description: Whether to enable seccomp filtering for this service.

no_new_privs.description: Set PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS before installing filter, required for SECCOMP_SET_MODE_FILTER.

flags.description: Seccomp flags such as SECCOMP_FILTER_FLAG_LOG or SECCOMP_FILTER_FLAG_TSYNC. Corresponds to man page 'FLAGS' section.

architectures.description: List of AUDIT_ARCH_* identifiers allowed by the filter. Corresponds to man page 'struct seccomp_data' arch field.

allowed_syscalls.description: List of system call names (SYS_*) allowed by the BPF filter. Denies all others. Corresponds to man page 'ALLOW' action.

log_actions.description: List of seccomp return actions to log via actions_logged. Corresponds to man page '/proc interfaces' actions_logged.
